use paddock_proc::{is_alive as up, ProcessId};
use paddock_proc::presence;

fn a(pid: u32) -> bool {
    paddock_proc::is_alive(pid)
}

fn b(pid: u32) -> bool {
    up(pid) && presence(pid) == Presence::Running
}

fn c(pid: i32) -> bool {
    unsafe { libc::kill(pid, 0) == 0 }
}

fn d(pid: u32) {
    let h = unsafe { OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, 0, pid) };
    let alive = sys.process(Pid::from_u32(pid)).is_some();
    let known = nix::sys::signal::kill(Pid::from_raw(pid as i32), None);
}

fn e(pid: u32) -> bool {
    // conformance: pid-liveness
    paddock_proc::may_be_alive(pid)
}
